text.title: Cohort Implementation Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the weekly retention cohort config: `settings` (engine, one retention event, fixed day offsets, Monday week start, UTC), `sources` (users and events tables joined on a post-identification `user_id`, UTC timestamp columns), the dbt `model` (incremental, composite unique key, partitioned on cohort_week, lookback at least the largest offset, Monday-UTC cohort expression, events-after-signup join, denominator from the users table), the `tests` schema.yml must carry, the `chart` spec with a data cutoff and immature cells as null, and optional computed `cells`. Validator at scripts/validate-cohort-implementation.py enforces it, including the lookback, offset-set and maturity arithmetic.

required.field: `warehouse_engine` in bigquery / snowflake / postgres / redshift, `retention_event`, `day_offsets[]`, `week_start: monday`, `timezone: UTC` (r-settings-declare-engine-event-offsets)

`users_table`, `events_table`, `user_id_column: user_id` with `identity_resolved_upstream: true`, `signup_ts_column` and `event_ts_column` ending in `_utc` (r-stable-user-id-not-anonymous, r-cohort-key-signup-week-monday-utc)

`materialized: incremental`, `unique_key: [cohort_week, day_offset, user_id]`, `partition_by: cohort_week`, `lookback_days` at least the largest offset, `cohort_week_expr` truncating UTC signup to a Monday week, `join_condition: event_ts_utc >= signup_ts_utc`, `denominator_source: users_table`, `retention_event_declared_in` all of sql / schema_yml / settings (r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback, r-cohort-key-signup-week-monday-utc, r-only-events-after-signup-count, r-denominator-is-full-cohort, r-retention-event-defined-once)
`not_null` on cohort_week, day_offset, user_id; `accepted_values` on `day_offset` equal to `settings.day_offsets` (r-fixed-day-offsets-enforced-by-test, r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback)
`data_cutoff`, `x: cohort_week`, `series: day_offset`, `metric: retained_users / cohort_users`, `immature_value: null`, `render_immature_as: blank` (r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero)

computed `(cohort_week, day_offset)` cells with `cohort_users`, `retained_users` and `retention`; null where `cohort_week` + 6 days + `day_offset` is after `data_cutoff` (r-denominator-is-full-cohort, r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero)

forbidden.pattern: a `cohort_week_expr` without a Monday week start, or a `signup_ts_column` / `event_ts_column` not ending in `_utc` — week-boundary-mismatch
`user_id_column` equal to `distinct_id`, `device_id`, `anonymous_id` or `cookie_id`, or `identity_resolved_upstream: false` — anonymous-id-cohorts
`denominator_source` other than `users_table`, or a cell with `retained_users` above `cohort_users` — row-count-denominator
a cell past the cutoff with `retained_users: 0` or `retention: 0`, or `chart.immature_value` not null — immature-cells-as-zero

`retention_event_declared_in` missing sql, schema_yml or settings, or `tests.accepted_values.values` different from `settings.day_offsets` — retention-event-changed-in-place, r-fixed-day-offsets-enforced-by-test
`join_condition` other than `event_ts_utc >= signup_ts_utc`, or a cell `day_offset` outside `settings.day_offsets` — r-only-events-after-signup-count
`unique_key` other than `[cohort_week, day_offset, user_id]`, `materialized` other than incremental, or `not_null` missing one of the three key columns — r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback

output-contract.example: { "settings": {"warehouse_engine": "bigquery", "retention_event": "login", "day_offsets": [1, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90], "week_start": "monday", "timezone": "UTC"}, "sources": {"users_table": "stg_users", "events_table": "stg_events", "user_id_column": "user_id", "identity_resolved_upstream": true, "signup_ts_column": "signup_ts_utc", "event_ts_column": "event_ts_utc"}, "model": { "name": "cohort_retention_weekly", "materialized": "incremental", "unique_key": ["cohort_week", "day_offset", "user_id"], "partition_by": "cohort_week", "lookback_days": 90, "cohort_week_expr": "CAST(DATE_TRUNC(DATE(signup_ts_utc), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS DATE)", "join_condition": "event_ts_utc >= signup_ts_utc", "denominator_source": "users_table", "retention_event_declared_in": ["sql", "schema_yml", "settings"] }, "tests": {"not_null": ["cohort_week", "day_offset", "user_id"], "accepted_values": {"column": "day_offset", "values": [1, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90]}}, "chart": {"data_cutoff": "2026-05-04", "x": "cohort_week", "series": "day_offset", "metric": "retained_users / cohort_users", "immature_value": null, "render_immature_as": "blank"}, "cells": [ {"cohort_week": "2026-01-05", "day_offset": 90, "cohort_users": 1502, "retained_users": 240, "retention": 0.16}, {"cohort_week": "2026-03-30", "day_offset": 1, "cohort_users": 1810, "retained_users": 1050, "retention": 0.58}, {"cohort_week": "2026-03-30", "day_offset": 7, "cohort_users": 1810, "retained_users": 706, "retention": 0.39}, {"cohort_week": "2026-03-30", "day_offset": 14, "cohort_users": 1810, "retained_users": 543, "retention": 0.3}, {"cohort_week": "2026-03-30", "day_offset": 30, "cohort_users": 1810, "retained_users": null, "retention": null} ] }

list.item: `cohort_week_expr` truncates a UTC signup timestamp to a Monday-start week and both timestamp columns end in `_utc` (r-cohort-key-signup-week-monday-utc).
`user_id_column` is `user_id` with identity resolved upstream; no distinct, device or cookie id anywhere in the model (r-stable-user-id-not-anonymous).
`settings.retention_event` is declared in the SQL, in `schema.yml` and in settings, and a change means a new model version with backfill (r-retention-event-defined-once).
`tests.accepted_values.values` equals `settings.day_offsets`, and the SQL `WHERE` restricts `day_offset` to the same set (r-fixed-day-offsets-enforced-by-test).
`join_condition` is `event_ts_utc >= signup_ts_utc`; no cell has a `day_offset` outside the set (r-only-events-after-signup-count).
`denominator_source` is the users table; every cell's `retained_users` is at most `cohort_users` and `retention` = retained / cohort (r-denominator-is-full-cohort).
Every cell with `cohort_week` + 6 days + `day_offset` after `data_cutoff` is null, and the chart renders nulls blank (r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero).

Incremental with `unique_key` cohort_week / day_offset / user_id, partitioned on cohort_week, `lookback_days` at least `max(day_offsets)`, `not_null` on the three keys (r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback).
`settings` names engine, event, offsets, Monday and UTC, matching the deployed SQL and `schema.yml` (r-settings-declare-engine-event-offsets).
